shots.action: Close on the mayor at his desk: he has just looked up, eyes wide; two bayonets slide in past the lens and stop at his chest; he jumps to his feet, hands in the air, mouth open
shots.camera: Eye level across the desk, pushing in and tilting up with him

shots.action: Low by the floor: the captain strides in through the double doors (jaw set), six soldiers behind him in two files, boots stamping, rifles on their shoulders, bayonets up
shots.camera: Floor level, looking up at the doorway, rising a little

shots.action: From the desk, looking up: the captain halts, throws out his arm and points, barking an order (brows down, mouth working); two bayonets flank him
shots.camera: Low angle from the desk, swinging round him

shots.action: The mayor behind his desk with his hands up, shaking, looking from one soldier to the other (eyes wide); two soldiers come round the desk and take him by the arms; his hands come down

Rook is already there, sitting on the front of the mayor's desk, arms crossed, hat brim low (unimpressed): 'Arrested for what, exactly?' He glances back at the arrest on the last word; the mayor stands held between the two soldiers behind him
shots.camera: Medium on Rook, the arrest in frame behind him

shots.action: Over the captain's shoulder and outstretched glove: the treasurer, trembling (eyes wide behind his glasses), lowers the town's cash box onto the counting table; the open safe behind him; a soldier's bayonet at the edge of frame
Down on the table: bundles of notes, stacks of gold coins and small sacks; a white-gloved hand sweeps them one after another into a leather bag; the treasurer's hand shakes on the open cash box
shots.camera: High, looking down at the table, turning

shots.action: Rook at the end of the table, eyes wide at a stack of gold (shiny): his hand creeps out; a bayonet drops across in front of his beak; he pulls the hand back, palms up, brim down (caught)
shots.camera: Medium on Rook across the table

shots.action: In the square, the brick town hall behind: six soldiers in a row with grounded rifles; the captain walks down the line towards us, hands behind his back, and each man stiffens and lifts his chin as he passes (faces set)
shots.camera: Low along the line, swinging with the captain

shots.action: From the foot of the steps: the mayor comes down between two soldiers, head bowed (brows knitted), hands behind him; two more stand rigid at the door
shots.camera: Low angle up the steps, drifting

shots.action: Rook leans in at the captain's shoulder and prods the silver epaulette with one finger, eyes narrowed (suspicious); the captain stares ahead, then slides a hard look down at him
Wide on the town hall and its tower: the captain comes down the steps with a leather bag and walks away across the square; the soldiers stay exactly where he left them
Rook on the steps between two soldiers who do not move: he looks left, looks right (eyes narrowed), and shrugs
A back alley under a gas lamp: the captain glances over his shoulder and lifts off his cap: a bald old man with a grey moustache; his hard face lets go and almost smiles
shots.camera: Close on his face, pushing in

shots.action: A bare room: the same old man in a leather apron on a stool at a cobbler's bench, hammering a sole on an iron last (tired eyes); he stops and looks up at us
Rook holds one of the old man's boots up by the heel, looks from it to us; his beak drops and his hat hops off his head (shocked); the old man goes on hammering behind him
A second-hand shop full of old coats: the old man in a shabby jacket, chin in hand, in front of a tailor's dummy wearing a captain's tunic and cap; he nods and points: that one (a small smile)
Rook goes over the tunic's brass buttons with his magnifying glass (squinting), a button glinting; then he straightens and taps his beak
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter on Rook and the dummy

shots.action: By the shop mirror: he does up the last button, sets the cap on his head, and draws himself up; the tired face goes hard: a captain
A Berlin street of tall houses and gas lamps: ten soldiers marching in two files; the captain steps into their path with his hand up, giving an order, and they stamp to a halt (eyes front)
Marching towards us: the captain out in front, the ten behind him in step, and Rook keeping pace at his elbow, looking him up and down, then turning to us with a shrug
shots.camera: Tracking backwards ahead of the column

shots.action: The alley: two policemen in spiked helmets close in from either side and take the old man by the shoulders; he starts (eyes wide), then lifts his hands a little and lets them (tired)
A stone cell with a barred window: the old man on the bunk, head down; Rook sitting beside him, tapping his beak, then looking at him sideways (softer)
A palace study in red and gold: a man in a pale uniform with an upturned moustache lowers his newspaper, shakes with laughter (mouth open, eyes creased), and brings a stamp down on a sheet of paper
The cell door swings open; Rook, in the corridor, sweeps an arm: after you; the old man steps out and blinks up at the light (eyes wide)

From the stalls, over hats and heads: red curtains part on a painted town hall, and there he is in the uniform, in the spotlight, saluting the house (pleased with himself); the audience starts to clap
From the stage: the front row clapping, and Rook in the middle of it, beak wide in a caw of a laugh, clapping too
shots.camera: From the stage, on Rook in the front row

shots.action: On the boards: the old man sweeps his cap off in a deep bow (smiling) as flowers land round his boots; behind him, by a scenery flat, Rook claps slowly and then touches his brim
Rook alone between the half-drawn curtains: he spots a brass button on the boards, picks it up, turns it in the footlights so it glints, pockets it and tugs his brim: 'Case closed.'

Back in the mayor's office, a moment earlier: the mayor writing at his desk; the camera closes in; he looks up, eyes going wide, and two bayonet tips slide into the edges of the frame: the opening frame
shots.camera: From the doorway, closing in to the opening framing
